requirements.text: The portal should allow online appointment booking while maintaining options for phone and in-person scheduling.
The portal should include user guides or tips to help patients navigate the system, as well as a way for them to reach out for assistance.
The portal should enable online requests for repeat prescriptions, with staff able to follow up via phone or secure messaging when necessary.
The system should support the personal touch by providing options for direct communication, ensuring patients feel comfortable reaching out.
The portal must prioritize patient data security and privacy, with appropriate measures in place to protect sensitive information.
